task.description: Apply REQ-237's PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority): marker convention to every .zig source-path citation in lib/letflow/api/* and lib/letflow/plugs/* (chunk 238e, 10 files), per the design doc's §2 structural placement rule (single citation line / whole paragraph / whole table, never per-table-row) and precedents established by REQ-243/244/246/247/248/249 (# -prefixed marker for citations inside Elixir # comments; headings whose own title contains a .zig mention marked directly; bullet/numbered-list items each get their own standalone marker). Pure text insertion, no code logic changed.

result.summary: Before: grep -rcF 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' across the 10 files summed to 0 (confirmed genuine before-state). grep -l '\.zig' lib/letflow/api/* lib/letflow/plugs/* matched exactly the 10 files predicted (response.ex, context.ex, authorization.ex, validation.ex, pagination.ex, error.ex, content_type.ex, api_pipeline.ex, tenant_status.ex, auth_pipeline.ex), totaling 74 .zig occurrences. After marking, grep -c '\.zig' on the same 10 files still totals 74 (identical per-file counts), confirming zero citation text was lost or altered -- every citation unit now has a PROVENANCE marker immediately above it (verified programmatically: for each of the 74 .zig-bearing lines, a marker line exists between it and the nearest preceding blank line). 61 marker lines were inserted total (fewer than 74 because paragraph/table/list-item units group multiple .zig mentions under one marker). Sample diff across response.ex, context.ex, pagination.ex, validation.ex, and error.ex (git diff) shows only added '+' lines (the markers) -- zero '-' lines (removed/altered text) in any of the 10 files. Divergence-phrase grep ('unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co') found exactly one match both before and after, in lib/letflow/api/response.ex, with byte-identical text ('**Error responses:** `application/problem+json`. This diverges from R-Co:') -- its line number shifted from 27 to 30 only because three PROVENANCE markers were inserted earlier in the same file (unavoidable given the file-wide mechanical insertion; the requirement's own acceptance criterion asks that this line be textually unmodified, which it is). No Elixir/mix toolchain is available in this sandbox (`which mix` returned nothing, no elixir/asdf binaries found) -- mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test could not be run; this is stated explicitly rather than claimed. Changes committed locally (not pushed) as d621dbc3 on feature/WF02-REQ250-20260905.
